scope: Isolated private-copy comparison of 32 and 128 MiB CPU convolution patch budgets at four fixed shapes. Existing common scalar/replay controls execute first. This does not modify production Builder or run a full model.

decision.reason: The short screen is mixed and noisy: the 32 by 32 case regresses, the mathematically identical 16 by 16 control differs by about 10%, and the 64 by 64 case nearly doubles its graph arena. It does not justify a blanket 128 MiB policy.
decision.targeted_lead: The VAE convolution at 512 by 512 has a 1.217x measured median ratio and a lower arena, but remains a private component lead requiring separate qualification before integration.

qualification.resource_caveat: External npm package installation and synchronization/compression processes appear in before/after snapshots. Three alternating samples per arm are an indicative screen, not a statistically stable performance result.
qualification.memory_caveat: Per-arm arena sizes describe graph storage. The direct-child RSS includes both graphs and untimed retained cold outputs/downloads; it is not model inference RSS.

contents.timing_scope: Bounded isolated persistent-graph screen; no model inference or original-model parity claim.

contents.status: prepared with exact replay/immutable-weight controls; no native compilation or execution
contents.scope: One bounded 32 versus128 MiB CPU convolution-strip comparison using copied actual Builder and existing scalar/replay controls. Not a production feature or model speed claim.
contents.candidate_policy: Only consider production integration if output checks pass and meaningful representative gains outweigh added arena memory. Default32 remains unchanged.
contents.actual_selection_evidence: Per-arm im2col node census and maximum patch bytes; both constrained to the stated cap.

controls.every_warm_output: Byte-exact comparison to the same arm cold output after recording the graph compute duration.
controls.resident_weights: Both arms download and byte-compare resident kernel and bias to immutable fixture values after all timed computes.
controls.resident_input: Byte-exact input check and exactly one upload per arm.
controls.execution_accounting: Exactly one cold compute plus the declared warm iteration count; each warm output is checked.
controls.selection: Assert each actual im2col census equals its predeclared arm count, not merely a nonzero count.

contents.timing_scope: Builder.compute_ms deltas only; every download, exact replay comparison, final kernel/bias/input check, and scalar oracle remains outside those deltas. Alternating order is retained.
contents.memory_scope: Per-arm graph allocation is reported separately. Untimed validation also retains two cold output vectors and temporarily downloads each warm output; this is model-free probe RSS, not full-model memory.
contents.pre_unit_environment: Run the initial existing scalar/replay controls with CRISPEMBED_TEST_CONV_WORKSPACE_MIB unset or explicitly32; only the bounded benchmark changes it to32/128 per arm.
contents.review_request_addressed: MI review: every warm output versus the same-arm cold, resident kernel/bias bytes after timing, and exact3-to1/2-to1/1-to1/37-to10 strip-count admission.
contents.compile_scope: Compile the copied Builder and private test against actual repository headers and current core/ggml archives; no ordinary Builder archive is linked.
